summary: $40-45, Apr 1-Nov 1 confirmed; hookups -> 50A, water, sewer (9 lots); store and phone booking added; note cleaned.
flags: PRIVATE GATE FACTS: posted $40 (W/E) and $45 (full hookup), under $50. Good Sam stored false. No gateway (Indianapolis 88 km). Presence: own working site, phone 765-234-7286 matches, Google. Family has not stayed. GOOGLE MAPS 4.7 over 181. So-so review quoted: 'It was ok. Good price. I didn't like the bathroom/showers. Not private, not enough hooks or seats. Our PT site was long enough but we were on quite a lean' (Google, 6 months ago).

LONG STAY (test 4): the site posts 38 nightly lots (29 W/E + 9 full hookup) beside seasonal lots at $1,200 + electric ($2,000 for 'the new lots in the back'). It calls itself 'a seasonal campground'. Against the stored 117 sites, nightly share is about 32%. Reviewers: 'Most are permanent spaces', 'a lot of permanent campers'. Nights are plainly sold: RV Life shows overnighters through 9/2026. The total count is not on the site; 117 came from the old note.
EXPANSION: imagery shows a large earthworks area just west of the camp, likely the 'new lots in the back'. More seasonal lots would lower the nightly share further. Not confirmed by the operator.

WATERFRONT LEAD: stored 'lakefront' looks high; I left it. Imagery: pads visible in the central arc are about 50 m from the lake's north shore, across the camp road and a lawn, and western pull-throughs about 45 m from its west end. Lake is about 3 acres by imagery. Reviewers: 'Parked right in front of the lake ... a pull-thru site next to the lake' and 'Nice lake view' (site 66). No map marks the lots, so I can't prove a site at the water; 'lakeview' looks like the supportable call.
PIN: stored 40.0850,-87.1066 good, on the camp road (Google 40.08494,-87.10778 sits ~100 m west).
